Download **lazy-deck-0.6.1.streamDeckPlugin** below and double-click it. Stream Deck installs or updates the plugin along with its profiles.

- **New keys:** **WeChat**, **LINE** and **KakaoTalk** launch their desktop apps with one press, right next to WhatsApp and Telegram. Lazy Deck now has 112 keys.
- Still speaks your language since 0.6.0: English, German, Spanish, French, Japanese, Korean, Simplified and Traditional Chinese. Requires Stream Deck 7.6 or newer.
